item.name: Security & Negative Tests
item.description: Grounded in services/api/koras_api/core/auth.py and core/tenant.py. Authentication and tenant resolution are two separate dependencies there: an unverifiable token is 401 (require_auth); a verified caller with no active tenant for their organization is 403, never 404 (require_tenant, by design -- see the docstring: 403, not 404 ... a 404 would send people to check their address instead of their access). The product resolves its tenant from the verified token's organization claim only -- it accepts no X-Tenant-Id or X-Organization-Id header, so none is sent here.

item.name: Missing Authorization header is refused (403, FastAPI HTTPBearer default)

request.description: HTTPBearer(auto_error=True) raises 403 'Not authenticated' when no Authorization header is present -- FastAPI's own default, not app logic. Distinct from an invalid token (401, below).

exec: pm.test('missing auth is refused with 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Malformed/invalid token is refused (401, error code token_invalid)

request.description: Source: core/auth.py require_auth() -- a TokenVerificationError is answered as 401 with the product's uniform error shape {code, message}; code is core/errors.py ApiErrorCode.TOKEN_INVALID = 'token_invalid'.

exec: pm.test('invalid token is refused with 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: A verified caller with no active tenant is refused with 403, not 404

request.description: Requires a real, verifiable token whose organization is not provisioned as a tenant of this product (e.g. a ZITADEL user with no membership here). Source: core/tenant.py require_tenant() -- deliberately 403 rather than 404, so the caller learns it is an access problem and not a wrong URL. This request cannot supply such a token generically; set no_tenant_access_token in the environment to exercise it, or skip.

exec: pm.test('no active tenant is refused with 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
} else { pm.test.skip('no_tenant_access_token not set in the environment -- this case needs a real, verifiable token for an organization with no tenant here'); }

item.name: Conditional write without If-Match is refused with 428 (precondition_required)

request.description: Docoris write-concurrency convention (decided 2026-09-21): an update with no If-Match header is refused with 428, code precondition_required. Only present on products carrying accounts.py (Docoris); a product without it answers 404 for the route instead, which this test tolerates. Needs account_id set in the environment.

exec: pm.test.skip('needs access_token and account_id in the environment');
pm.test.skip('this product has no /accounts route (not Docoris) -- 404 is expected, not a failure');
pm.test('missing If-Match is refused with 428', () => pm.response.to.have.status(428));

item.name: Malformed query is never answered with 500

request.description: An out-of-enum query value. If this parameter is a closed enum, FastAPI/Pydantic validation refuses it (422) before the route body runs; this test only asserts 'not a 500' rather than a specific code, since inventing the exact validation contract of a query parameter not read from code would be a guess.

exec: pm.test('never answers 500 on a bad query value', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));
} else { pm.test.skip('no access_token set in the environment'); }
